public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<html><head><style>body { color: red; }</style></head><body><style>.foo { margin: 0; }</style></body></html>", ConversionOptions.builder().build());
        System.out.println(result);
